name: skill-gap
description: Audit recent agent work for recurring manual patterns that have no skill yet, cross-check against installed skills and public skill catalogs (installing beats building), and propose the top two or three as before/after. Read-only analysis. Triggers: "/skill-gap", "what skills should I build", "audit my skills".
